sources.snippet: Model description AfriBERTa base is a pretrained multilingual language model with around 111 million parameters. The model has 8 layers, 6 attention heads, 768 hidden units and 3072 feed forward size. The model was pretrained on 11 African languages namely - Afaan Oromoo (also called Oromo), Amharic, Gahuza (a mixed language containing Kinyarwanda and Kirundi), Hausa, Igbo, Nigerian Pidgin ...
